(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define sep (filter (lambda (c) (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg) (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 (rows g))))) (range 0 (cols g))))
   (define start (if (empty? sep) 0 (+ 1 (apply max sep))))
   (define panel (subgrid g 0 start (- (rows g) 1) (- (cols g) 1)))
   (define first-panel (subgrid g 0 0 (- (rows g) 1) (if (empty? sep) (- (cols g) 1) (- (apply min sep) 1))))
   (define obs (objects-8 first-panel bg))
   (define cursor (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) obs)))
   (define template (obj-cells cursor))
   (define (dot p d) (+ (* (first p) (first d)) (* (second p) (second d))))
   (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1)))
   (define (tip-for d)
    (let* ((extent (apply max (map (lambda (p) (dot p d)) template)))
           (end (filter (lambda (p) (= (dot p d) extent)) template)))
     (if (= (length end) 1) (first end) #f)))
   (define initial-heading
    (first (filter
     (lambda (d)
      (let* ((tip (tip-for d)) (perp (list (second d) (- (first d))))
             (back (apply min (map (lambda (p) (dot p d)) template))))
       (and tip (> (count-if (lambda (p) (= (dot p d) back)) template) 1)
            (all? (lambda (p)
                    (let ((off (- (dot p perp) (dot tip perp))))
                     (member (list (- (first p) (* 2 off (first perp)))
                                   (- (second p) (* 2 off (second perp)))) template))) template)))) dirs)))
   (define initial-tip (tip-for initial-heading))
   (define (cw p) (list (second p) (- (first p))))
   (define (spin p n) (if (= n 0) p (spin (cw p) (- n 1))))
   (define ink (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p))) (filter (lambda (p) (!= (third p) bg)) (grid-cells panel))))
   (define matches
    (apply append (map (lambda (n)
     (filter (lambda (candidate) (all? (lambda (p) (member p ink)) (third candidate)))
      (map (lambda (anchor)
       (list anchor (spin initial-heading n)
        (map (lambda (p)
         (let ((v (spin (list (- (first p) (first initial-tip)) (- (second p) (second initial-tip))) n)))
          (list (+ (first anchor) (first v)) (+ (second anchor) (second v))))) template))) ink))) (range 0 4))))
   (define found (first matches))
   (define tip (first found))
   (define heading (second found))
   (define cells (third found))
   (define dots (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p cells))) ink))
   (define (distance p q) (+ (abs (- (first p) (first q))) (abs (- (second p) (second q)))))
   (define trace
    (let loop ((pos tip) (todo dots) (direction heading))
     (if (empty? todo) (list pos direction)
      (let* ((aligned (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (first pos)) (= (second p) (second pos)))) todo))
             (next (first (sort aligned (lambda (a b) (< (distance a pos) (distance b pos))))))
             (dr (- (first next) (first pos))) (dc (- (second next) (second pos)))
             (length (+ (abs dr) (abs dc))))
       (loop next (filter (lambda (p) (not (equal? p next))) todo) (list (/ dr length) (/ dc length)))))))
   (define target (first trace))
   (define final-heading (second trace))
   (define (rotate p)
    (let turn ((v p) (d heading))
     (if (equal? d final-heading) v (turn (cw v) (cw d)))))
   (define moved
    (map (lambda (p)
      (let ((v (rotate (list (- (first p) (first tip)) (- (second p) (second tip))))))
       (list (+ (first target) (first v)) (+ (second target) (second v))))) cells))
   (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows panel) (cols panel) bg) moved (obj-color cursor)))))
